mcqs.question: Consider the sets A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}. Which of the following statements correctly defines the relationship between A and B?

options.A: A is a subset of B
options.B: A is a superset of B
options.C: A and B are disjoint sets

mcqs.answer: A is a subset of B
mcqs.explanation: Every element of A (1, 2, 3) is also an element of B, so by definition A ⊆ B. Option B is wrong because A does not contain all elements of B. Option C is wrong because they share elements. Option D is wrong because B has extra elements.

mcqs.question: Let X = {a, b} and Y = {a, b, c}. Which statement correctly describes their relationship?

options.A: X is a proper subset of Y
options.B: Y is a proper subset of X
options.C: X and Y are equal sets

mcqs.answer: X is a proper subset of Y
mcqs.explanation: All elements of X are in Y and Y has at least one element (c) not in X, satisfying the definition of a proper subset (X ⊂ Y). Options B, C, and D do not satisfy the definition.

mcqs.learning_point: Determine whether one set is a subset of another
mcqs.question: Set P = {1, 2} and set Q = {2, 3}. Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: P is a subset of Q
options.B: P is not a subset of Q
options.C: Q is a subset of P
options.D: Both P and Q are subsets of each other

mcqs.answer: P is not a subset of Q
mcqs.explanation: For P to be a subset of Q, every element of P must belong to Q. Element 1 is not in Q, so P ⊄ Q. Hence option B is correct. Options A, C, and D are false because the required element inclusion does not hold.

mcqs.learning_point: Find subsets of a finite set
mcqs.question: The set S = {p, q, r} has how many distinct subsets (including the empty set and S itself)?
mcqs.explanation: A set with n elements has 2^n subsets. Here n = 3, so 2^3 = 8 subsets. Options A, B, and D are incorrect calculations.

mcqs.question: Set M has 4 elements while set N has 5 elements. Which set has a greater number of subsets?

options.C: Both have the same number of subsets
options.D: It cannot be determined without knowing the actual elements

mcqs.explanation: Number of subsets = 2^n. For M, 2^4 = 16 subsets; for N, 2^5 = 32 subsets. Therefore N has more subsets. Options A, C, and D are incorrect.

mcqs.question: If T = {x, y}, which of the following is the power set \(\mathcal{P}(T)\)?
mcqs.explanation: The power set contains all possible subsets of T: the empty set, each singleton, and the set itself. Hence \(\mathcal{P}(T) = \{\emptyset, \{x\}, \{y\}, \{x, y\}\}\). Options A, C, and D omit some subsets.

mcqs.question: Which of the following best defines a subset?

options.A: A set A is a subset of set B if every element of A is also an element of B.
options.B: A set A is a subset of set B if A and B have at least one common element.
options.C: A set A is a subset of set B if A contains all elements of B.
options.D: A set A is a subset of set B if A and B are disjoint.

mcqs.answer: A set A is a subset of set B if every element of A is also an element of B.
mcqs.explanation: The definition of a subset (A ⊆ B) requires that each element of A belongs to B. Option B describes a non‑empty intersection, not a subset. Option C describes a superset, and option D describes disjoint sets.

mcqs.question: What distinguishes a proper subset from a regular subset?

options.A: A proper subset must contain at least one element that is not in the original set.
options.B: A proper subset contains all elements of the original set and possibly more.
options.C: A proper subset is a subset that is equal to the original set.
options.D: A proper subset has no elements in common with the original set.

mcqs.answer: A proper subset must contain at least one element that is not in the original set.
mcqs.explanation: A proper subset A of B (A ⊂ B) satisfies A ⊆ B and A ≠ B, meaning B has at least one element not in A. Option B describes a superset, C describes equality, and D describes disjoint sets.
